name: Google Workspace
description: Run Google Workspace operations through the gws CLI, including Gmail inbox triage.

gws_binary.description: Path or executable name for the Google Workspace CLI.

default_user_id.description: Default Gmail user id for mailbox operations.

default_query.description: Default Gmail query for unread message triage.

prerequisites.agent_guidance: Install the required CLIs one prerequisite at a time. Auto-run only the manifest-declared shell commands. If a step needs manual work, explain why, open the install docs, and stop after the prerequisite verifies successfully.

cli.name: Google Workspace CLI
cli.why: This plugin executes Gmail and other Google Workspace actions through the gws CLI.

install_options.label: Install with npm
install_options.description: Installs the Google Workspace CLI globally with npm.

install_options.label: Open install docs
install_options.description: Use this if npm is unavailable or the automatic install fails.

cli.name: Google Cloud SDK
cli.why: The gws auth flow depends on the Google Cloud SDK being available on the host.

install_options.label: Install with Homebrew
install_options.description: Uses Homebrew to install the Google Cloud SDK on macOS.

install_options.label: Open install docs
install_options.description: Use the Google Cloud SDK install guide if automatic installation is not available.

oauth.description: Runs the gws agent-assisted auth flow in the daemon.
oauth.agent_prompt: Use gws auth setup for first-run OAuth bootstrap. If the CLI asks for manual Google Cloud Console setup, complete it and rerun plugin setup.
